name: Nireida Yukihito
source:
Yukihito, a young man in his mid-twenties, is notably dispassionate, introverted, and lacks distinct ambition. His hobbies, talents, and moral sense are as ordinary as he is.

By serendipity, he finds himself in Kimachi Village. Upon arrival, the villagers greet him as a deity, reverently addressing him as "Omeguri-sama."

As a religious study major in college with a keen interest in folklore, he finds the village customs intriguing, albeit shocking. Nonetheless, he endeavors to understand them.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/erewhon/character.html#char00]official website[/url]]
